mapper.select: SELECT t.TASK_ID ,t.PROJECT_ID ,t.TITLE ,t.CONTENTS ,t.CREATED_DATE ,t.USER_ID ,t.ALGORITHM ,t.CONFIG ,t.IS_ENABLE ,t.IS_FIXED ,t.LABEL_TYPE FROM TASK t WHERE 1=1 AND PROJECT_ID = #{project_id} AND IS_ENABLE = #{is_enable} AND USER_ID = #{user_id} AND TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{title},'%') AND CONTENTS LIKE CONCAT('%',#{contents},'%') AND LABEL_TYPE = #{label_type} ORDER BY t.CREATED_DATE DESC LIMIT ${page_num}, ${page_size}

SELECT t.TASK_ID ,t.PROJECT_ID ,t.TITLE ,t.CONTENTS ,t.CREATED_DATE ,t.USER_ID ,t.ALGORITHM ,t.CONFIG ,t.IS_ENABLE ,t.ALGORITHM_ID ,t.IS_FIXED ,t.LABEL_TYPE FROM TASK t WHERE 1=1 AND t.TASK_ID = #{task_id}
SELECT t.TITLE AS TASK_TITLE ,p.TITLE AS PROJECT_TITLE FROM TASK t LEFT JOIN PROJECT p ON t.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND t.TASK_ID = #{task_id} AND t.PROJECT_ID = #{project_id}
SELECT t.TASK_ID ,t.TITLE FROM TASK t WHERE 1=1 AND TITLE = #{title} AND PROJECT_ID = #{project_id}
SELECT t.TASK_ID ,t.BASE_TASK_ID FROM TASK t WHERE 1=1 AND t.BASE_TASK_ID = #{base_task_id}
